description: This source file implements the LocationSync plugin class in C++, handling location synchronization, registration of remote procedure calls, property management, and event notification within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: LocationSync
classes.description: A class that manages location synchronization, including registration of RPC methods, property handling, and event signaling within the plugin framework.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers RPC endpoints and properties for the LocationSync plugin.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all previously registered RPC endpoints and properties.

methods.name: endpoint_sync
